title: Biofuel Generation
subtitle: Fuel-burner generation without new machine rules
summary: Biofuel generators accept valid furnace fuel and buffer EP for machine startups.
body: Place a Biofuel Generator beside a cable or battery, then shift-use with fuel in hand or open its node menu. Treat it as a higher-output fuel burner: it is stronger than the Scrap Burner, but it still needs storage and routing to avoid brownouts.
